([[Hillside, New Jersey]]) | college = [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]] (2017–2020) | draft_year = 2020 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 42 | draft_team = [[New Orleans Pelicans]] | career_start = 2020 | years1 = {{nbay|2020|start}}–{{nbay|2024|end}} | team1 = [[Charlotte Hornets]] | years2 = [[2020–21 NBA G League season|2021]] | team2 = →[[Greensboro Swarm]] | years3 = {{nbay|2024|end}}–{{nbay|2025|end}} | team3 = [[Phoenix Suns]] | years4 = {{nbay|2025|end}} | team4 = [[Chicago Bulls]] | years5 = {{nbay|2026|start}}–present | team5 = [[Miami Heat]] | highlights = * First-team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] (2020) * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2017 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2017]]) }} '''Nicholas Richards''' (born November 29, 1997) is a Jamaican professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Miami Heat]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]]. ==High school career== [[File:20170329 MCDAAG Nicholas Richards on the fast break.jpg|thumb|left|Richards at the [[2017 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2017 McDonald's All-American Game]]]] Born and raised in [[Kingston, Jamaica]],{{Cite web|url=https://davesjoint.net/2016/09/19/nick-richards-the-journey-from-jamaica-to-jersey/|title=Nick Richards: The Journey from Jamaica to Jersey|date=September 19, 2016|access-date=July 9, 2017|website=davesjoint.net|last=Cordova|first=David}} Richards attended [[Jamaica College]]{{Cite web |date=2020-11-24 |title=Cunningham, JC proud of Nick Richards |url=https://jamaica-gleaner.com/article/sports/20201124/cunningham-jc-proud-nick-richards |access-date=2022-11-14 |website=jamaica-gleaner.com |language=en}} and competed in football, volleyball and track and field before being discovered by Andre Ricketts, a [[New York City]]-based basketball scout, in the summer of 2013 during a basketball camp in Jamaica. {{Cite web|url=https://www.zagsblog.com/2016/11/10/journey-jamaica-jersey-nick-richards-commits-kentucky/|title=After Journey from Jamaica to Jersey, Nick Richards Commits to Kentucky|last=Zagoria|first=Adam|date=November 10, 2016|website=Zagsblog|access-date=July 9, 2017}} Ricketts brought him to the U.S., where Richards attended [[St. Mary's High School (Manhasset, New York)|St. Mary's High School]] in [[Manhasset, New York]]. He transferred to [[The Patrick School]] in [[Hillside, New Jersey]] in 2014.{{Cite web|url=http://www.zagsblog.com/2014/10/23/big-man-nick-richards-with-kentucky-type-talent-transfers-to-the-patrick-school/|title=Big Man Nick Richards With 'Kentucky-Type Talent' Transfers to The Patrick School|last=Zagoria|first=Adam|date=October 23, 2014|website=Zagsblog|access-date=July 9, 2017}} He was ranked a five-star recruit in the class of 2017 (by [[ESPN]]) and committed to [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|the University of Kentucky]] in November 2016.{{Cite news|url=http://www.scout.com/college/basketball/recruiting/story/1726541-5-star-nick-richards-commits-to-kentucky|title=5-star Nick Richards commits to Kentucky|work=Scout.com|access-date=July 9, 2017|language=en|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161113151344/http://www.scout.com/college/basketball/recruiting/story/1726541-5-star-nick-richards-commits-to-kentucky|archive-date=November 13, 2016|url-status=dead}} He was UK's first commit in the class of 2017 and chose Kentucky over [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]] and [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]]. Richards played in the [[2017 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]],{{Cite news|url=http://usatodayhss.com/2017/kentucky-signee-nick-richards-calls-becoming-mcdonalds-all-american-a-dream-come-true|title=Kentucky signee Nick Richards calls becoming McDonald's All American a dream come true|date=January 25, 2017|work=USA Today High School Sports|access-date=July 9, 2017|language=en-US}} scoring two points, grabbing two rebounds and tallying two blocked shots in 14 minutes of action.{{Cite news|url=http://tucson.com/mcdonald-s-all-american-game-box-score/pdf_3a97a340-1506-11e7-9032-ff5c2217fb5e.html|title=2017 McDonald's All-American Game box score|work=Arizona Daily Star|access-date=July 6, 2017|language=en}} Participating in the 2017 [[Jordan Brand Classic]], he had ten points and three boards in 16 minutes of play.{{Cite web|url=http://jordanbrandclassic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-Jordan-Brand-Classic-National-Boys-Game.pdf|title=Official Basketball Box Score -- Game Totals -- Final Statistics East Team vs West Team|website=jordanbrandclassic.com|access-date=July 6, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170928010232/http://jordanbrandclassic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-Jordan-Brand-Classic-National-Boys-Game.pdf|archive-date=September 28, 2017|url-status=dead}} Richards was picked to play for the World Select Team at the 2017 [[Nike Hoop Summit]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/news/fiba-youth-stars-set-to-showcase-skills-at-nike-hoop-summit|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170415005840/http://www.fiba.com/news/fiba-youth-stars-set-to-showcase-skills-at-nike-hoop-summit|url-status=live|archive-date=April 15, 2017|title=FIBA youth stars set to showcase skills at Nike Hoop Summit|website=FIBA.basketball|date=April 7, 2017 |language=en|access-date=July 9, 2017}} He saw 19:29 minutes of action during the game, scoring 12 points and grabbing three rebounds.{{Cite web|url=https://www.usab.com/basketball/media/pdfs/2017/17-hsum-box-scorepdf.aspx|title=Nike Hoop Summit Box Scores|website=usab.com|access-date=July 9, 2017}}{{dead link|date=September 2023|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}} ==College career== Richards had then-career highs of 25 points and 15 rebounds on November 22, 2017, contributing to the Wildcats' 86–67 win over [[IPFW Mastodons basketball|IPFW]].{{cite news |title=No. 8 Kentucky finally has it easy against Fort Wayne, 86–67 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400987192 |access-date=November 9, 2019 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 22, 2017}} He averaged 5.1 points and 4.4 rebounds per game as a freshman but saw his playing time decrease as the season went on.{{cite news |last=Roberts |first=Ben |title=Forget what you saw last season. There's a new Nick Richards at Kentucky. |url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-basketball-men/article219452960.html |access-date=November 9, 2019 |work=[[Lexington Herald-Leader]] |date=October 8, 2018}} Richards posted 3.9 points and 3.3 rebounds per game as a sophomore and led the team in blocks. Following the season, he declared for the [[2019 NBA draft]] but opted to return to Kentucky.{{cite news |last=Hale |first=Jon |title=Nick Richards withdraws from NBA draft to return to Kentucky for junior season |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/kentucky/2019/05/28/kentucky-basketball-nick-richards-withdraws-nba-draft/3760187002/ |access-date=November 9, 2019 |work=[[Louisville Courier-Journal]] |date=May 28, 2019}} On November 8, 2019, Richards scored 21 points and grabbed 10 rebounds as Kentucky defeated [[2019–20 Eastern Kentucky Colonels men's basketball team|Eastern Kentucky]] 91–49.{{cite news |title=No. 2 Kentucky easily handles Eastern Kentucky 91–49 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401169808 |access-date=November 9, 2019 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 8, 2019}} He had 21 points, 12 rebounds and four blocks on January 4, 2020, in a 71–59 win over [[2019–20 Missouri Tigers men's basketball team|Missouri]].{{cite news |title=No. 17 Kentucky outlasts Missouri 71–59 in SEC opener |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401166272 |access-date=January 24, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=January 4, 2020}} Richards had 25 points including the two clinching free throws and 13 rebounds on January 25, in a 76–74 overtime win over [[2019–20 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]].{{cite news |title=No. 15 Kentucky pulls out 76-74 OT win at No. 18 Texas Tech |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401169716 |access-date=January 27, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=January 25, 2020}} On February 4, Richards set a new career high with 27 points on an 80–72 win over [[2019–20 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Mississippi State]].{{cite news |title=No. 15 Kentucky bounces back to beat Mississippi State 80–72 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401166327 |access-date=February 5, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=February 4, 2020}} At the conclusion of the regular season, Richards was named to the First Team All-SEC.{{cite press release|url=https://www.secsports.com/article/28877731/sec-announces-2020-men-basketball-awards |title=SEC announces 2020 Men's Basketball Awards |publisher=Southeastern Conference |date=March 10, 2020 |access-date=March 10, 2020}} He averaged 14 points, 7.8 rebounds and 2.1 blocks per game.{{cite news |last=Fisher |first=Chris |title=Four Wildcats projected among ESPN's top 60 NBA Draft prospects |url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/LongFormArticle/Four-Kentucky-Wildcats-projected-among-ESPNs-top-60-NBA-Draft-prospects-145082340/#145082340_2 |access-date=March 18, 2020 |work=247 Sports |date=March 16, 2020}} Following the season, Richards declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite news |last=Phillips |first=Scott |title=Nick Richards leaving Kentucky for 2020 NBA draft |url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2020/04/14/nick-richards/ |access-date=April 14, 2020 |work=[[NBC Sports]] |date=April 14, 2020}} ==Professional career== ===Charlotte Hornets / Greensboro Swarm (2020–2025)=== In the [[2020 NBA draft]], Richards was selected by the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] 42nd overall and immediately traded to the [[Charlotte Hornets]] in exchange for a [[2024 NBA draft|2024]] second-round pick.{{Cite web|title=Hornets Acquire Nick Richards|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/hornets-acquire-nick-richards|access-date=2020-11-20|website=NBA.com|language=en|date=November 19, 2020|last=Rochinski|first=Matt}} On November 30, 2020, he signed his rookie-scale contract with the Hornets.{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/press-releases/charlotte-hornets-sign-nick-richards|title=Charlotte Hornets Sign Nick Richards|work=NBA.com|date=November 30, 2020|access-date=December 5, 2020}} Richards was assigned to the [[Greensboro Swarm]] and made his [[NBA G League]] debut on February 21, 2021, scoring 26 points and grabbing 10 rebounds. During the 2020–21 NBA season, he saw minimal playing time, appearing in 18 games for the Hornets with an average of 3.5 minutes and 0.8 points per game.{{Cite web |title=Nick Richards {{!}} Charlotte Hornets |url=https://www.nba.com/stats/player/1630208/career |access-date=March 23, 2023 |website=NBA.com}} On December 6, 2021, Richards scored a season-high 12 points, alongside five rebounds and two assists, in a 127–124 overtime loss to the [[2021–22 Philadelphia 76ers season|Philadelphia 76ers]].{{Cite web |title=Embiid scores 43, 76ers hold off pesky Hornets 127-124 in OT |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022100353 |access-date=March 23, 2023 |website=NBA.com|date=December 7, 2021|last=Reed|first=Steve}} On October 19, 2022, Richards scored 19 points, alongside ten rebounds, in the Hornets' season-opening 129–102 win over the [[2022–23 San Antonio Spurs season|San Antonio Spurs]].{{Cite web |title=Rozier scores 24 as Hornets rout youthful Spurs, 129-102 |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022200011 |access-date=March 23, 2023 |website=NBA.com|date=October 19, 2022|last=Dominguez|first=Raul}} On October 23, he scored a then-career-high 20 points, alongside eleven rebounds and two blocks, in a 126–109 win over the [[2022–23 Atlanta Hawks season|Atlanta Hawks]].{{Cite web |title=Oubre, Richards power Hornets to 126-109 win over Hawks |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022200038 |access-date=March 23, 2023 |website=NBA.com|date=October 23, 2022|last=Henry|first=George}} On March 22, 2023, Richards signed a three-year, $15 million contract extension with the Hornets.{{Cite web |title=Hornets Sign Nick Richards To Multi-Year Extension |url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/hornets-sign-nick-richards-to-multi-year-extension |access-date=March 23, 2023 |website=NBA.com|date=March 22, 2023}}{{Cite web |title=Hornets, Nick Richards agree to 3-year, $15 million extension |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/35920623 |access-date=March 23, 2023 |website=ESPN.com|date=March 22, 2023 |last=Wojnarowski|first=Adrian|author-link=Adrian Wojnarowski}} On January 27, 2024, Richards scored a career-high 26 points, along with 13 rebounds in a 134–122 loss to the [[2023–24 Utah Jazz season|Utah Jazz]].{{cite web |date=January 27, 2024 |title=Markkanen scores 33, Jazz build 36-point lead in 134-122 victory over Hornets |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/401585275 |access-date=January 29, 2024 |website=ESPN.com|agency=Associated Press}} ===Phoenix Suns (2025–2026)=== On January 15, 2025, Richards was traded to the [[Phoenix Suns]] alongside one future second-round pick in exchange for [[Josh Okogie]] and three second-round picks.{{cite web|title=SUNS ACQUIRE CENTER NICK RICHARDS FROM CHARLOTTE|url=https://www.nba.com/suns/news/suns-acquire-center-nick-richards-from-charlotte|website=NBA.com|date=January 15, 2025|access-date=January 16, 2025}} Richards made his Suns debut three days later, putting up a double-double of 21 points and 11 rebounds off the bench in a 125–121 win over the [[2024–25 Detroit Pistons season|Detroit Pistons]].{{Cite web |last=Gauruder |first=Dana |date=2025-01-19 |title=Kevin Durant and Devin Booker power the Suns to a 125-121 win over the Pistons |url=https://www.nba.com/game/phx-vs-det-0022400586 |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=NBA.com |language=en |agency=Associated Press}} He ended up becoming the first center in Suns franchise history to record a double-double of at least 20 points and 10 rebounds in his debut game while coming off the bench.{{Cite web |last=Booth |first=Trevor |date=2025-01-19 |title=Game Recap: Suns down Pistons in Saturday afternoon clash, 125-121 |url=https://www.brightsideofthesun.com/2025/1/18/24346874/phoenix-suns-beat-detroit-pistons-durant-booker-richards-shine-2025-nba |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=Bright Side Of The Sun |language=en-US}} On January 25, Richards recorded a near 20/20 double-double with 20 points and a career-high 19 rebounds (15 of them coming from the first half, tying a previous season high of 15 he had in a previous match against the [[2024–25 Brooklyn Nets season|Brooklyn Nets]]{{Cite web |last=Voita |first=John |date=2025-01-26 |title=Game Recap: Phoenix Suns dominate Wizards behind Nick Richard's breakout night |url=https://www.brightsideofthesun.com/2025/1/25/24352135/phoenix-suns-vs-wizards-nick-richards-career-high-durant-booker-win-home-debut |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=Bright Side Of The Sun |language=en-US}}) in a 119–108 win over the [[2024–25 Washington Wizards season|Washington Wizards]] in his home debut for Phoenix.{{Cite web |last=Brandt |first=David |date=January 25, 2025 |title=Durant scores 29 points as the Suns hand the Wizards their 13th straight loss, 119-109 |url=https://www.nba.com/game/was-vs-phx-0022400645 |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=NBA.com |language=en}} He made 36 appearances (34 starts) for the Suns, recording averages of 9.5 points, 8.6 rebounds and 0.6 assists.{{Cite web|title=Nick Richards 2024-25 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4278076/type/nba/year/2025|access-date=April 6, 2026|website=ESPN.com}} Richards played in 28 contests (including two starts) for Phoenix during the [[2025–26 NBA season]], averaging 3.2 points, 3.3 rebounds and 0.3 assists.{{Cite web|title=Nick Richards 2025-26 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4278076/type/nba/year/2026|access-date=April 6, 2026|website=ESPN.com}} ===Chicago Bulls (2026)=== On February 5, 2026, Richards was traded to the [[Chicago Bulls]] in a three-team trade involving the [[Milwaukee Bucks]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/bulls/news/chicago-bulls-acquire-nick-richards-in-three-team-trade|title=CHICAGO BULLS ACQUIRE NICK RICHARDS IN THREE-TEAM TRADE|work=NBA.com|date=February 5, 2026|access-date=August 16, 2026}} === Miami Heat (2026–present) === On August 27, 2026, Richards signed with the [[Miami Heat]].{{Cite web |title=HEAT SIGN NICK RICHARDS {{!}} Miami Heat |url=https://heat.com/news/heat-sign-nick-richards |access-date=2026-08-27 |website=heat.com |language=en}} ==Career statistics==
